label: GO late in episode after rewarded a2->S2, belief favours S2, ramps with trial
terms: (phase == GO) * ((prev_reward == 1) & isin(prev_action, [2, -1]) & isin(prev_state, [2, -1])) * (belief_lo < 0) * np.clip(ep_trial - 84, 0, 15) ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(ep_trial - 84, 0, 15)
explanation: Active only at GO in the last ~15 trials of the episode. Magnitude is about 0.1 per trial past trial 84 (reaching ~2 by trial 99) when the previous trial was a2 -> S2 rewarded (or the previous trial is outside the window but the D1 reward input was 1) AND the ideal-observer belief says S2 is good (belief_lo < 0). Otherwise it is ~0, with a small negative general late-episode ramp correcting the timing baseline. Unrewarded trials, a1 trials, and rare a2->S1 rewarded trials do not drive it. D1 and D2 are always 0. Gating on belief is what matters: the same late-ramp term without the belief gate scored dev 0.58; adding the gate gave dev 0.85, test 0.80 R^2 beyond timing, well above the profile additive ceiling (all 0.09, all observed 0.08), because the effect is an interaction of reward-history x belief x episode time. Observed-only loses essentially nothing compared with a model value/policy description: belief stands in for the model internal S2-good estimate. Not tested: whether belief magnitude past the sign adds anything (a graded -belief_lo version scored slightly worse).

issues: The scores reproduce: the claimed terms give dev 0.848 and test 0.805 R^2 beyond timing, with weights +0.135 and -0.036.

The belief gate matters as claimed. Removing it drops test to 0.672. Moving the threshold off zero is worse: belief_lo<1 gives 0.788 and belief_lo<-1 gives 0.763. An extra term for prev rewarded a2->S2 with belief_lo>=0 gets weight about 0.01 (test 0.806), so the feature really is quiet when belief favours S1.

The claim that rare-rewarded a2->S1 trials do not drive it holds: adding last_is('a2 S1 r') x belief x ramp gets weight 0.003 and no gain. a1 S2 r is the largest under-predicted cell in misses, but only +0.011, and adding a term for it gets weight 0.022 with no gain (0.8055).
Misses show no large systematic error. Mean error by phase is within +/-0.003 and every phase x previous-trial cell is within +/-0.011. D1 and D2 are exactly 0, which matches 'always 0 at D1 and D2'.

Minor point on shape: the ramp is somewhat concave, not purely linear. Some windows are already at 1.1 to 2.0 by trials 90-94 while the linear term predicts 0.2 to 1.4. A saturating extra term, clip(ep_trial-84,0,6), lifts test to 0.820. Starting the ramp at trial 80 instead of 84 is worse (0.748). This small refinement does not undercut the label.

About 0.18 of the variance beyond timing is left unexplained and looks like scattered per-window noise (for example, single GO steps at 0 where the terms predict 1.5). It does not form a phase or previous-trial class. Graded belief (clip(-belief_lo,0,5)), belief_cover and a two-back rewarded-S2 condition each add 0.005 or less.
